column3: The Hebrew pictures the leaders’ and officials’ leading role as their hand being first in this unfaithfulness. The holy seed mingles itself actively; BSB uses a passive mixing.
The Hebrew says “shame of face”; BSB says “humiliation.”
The Hebrew expresses giving a little revival in bondage as a purpose; BSB describes the giving of new life as accomplished.
The Hebrew says a wall without explicitly adding “of protection,” which BSB supplies.
The Hebrew says “Your commandments”; BSB leaves the possessive to the following relative clause.
The Hebrew pictures mediation through the hand of the prophets and filling the land from mouth to mouth; BSB says “through” and “from end to end.”
The Hebrew says You withheld below our iniquity, without explicitly naming punishment; BSB supplies “punished” and what the iniquities deserve.
